text:
eli: Heads-up — dashboard shows weird behavior for /generate: p95 dropped ~30ms but p99 jumped ~400ms after the fallback routing change. Any ideas? :eyes:

maria: link to the chart? can you post the comparison view (routes + raw counts)?

eli: https://console.redwood/local/dash?endpoint=/generate&compare=route_weight

chao: weird, looks like p50/p95 are dominated by cache-hits but p99 is from a tiny tail of cold starts. sample_count for fallback route is tiny after the change.

nate: are we merging samples from client-timeouts/aborts? those can bias upper tail depending on where we drop them.

eli: good call. query I used: 
```
GET /telemetry/v1/query?group_by=route,quantile&quantiles=0.5,0.95,0.99&start=1670000000&end=1670003600
```
I also grabbed counts and saw fallback route had ~120 samples in the window while main route had ~12k.

maria: 120 samples is below our informal stability threshold. p99 from small N is super noisy. we should annotate the dashboard with min-sample warnings. :warning:

chao: also check KV cache skew — when prefix cache hits dominate p50/p95 decrease, but cold-start latency for model-variant fallback (quantized variant) spikes p99. different distributions.

sam-ux: UX idea: show a tiny overlay under percentile lines that shows sample_count and a colored stability bar (green/orange/red) and allow toggling a `min_samples=1000` smoothing mode.

nate: long-term we should compute a confidence interval for each percentile using bootstrap on the TDigest buckets or switch to a robust aggregation that requires a minimum effective weight.

chao: fwiw, we also saw clients in older SDK versions send a header that routed them to the fallback region — explains small sample pile. maybe rollout weights + client-version split = concentrated tail.

eli: ok next steps: 1) add sample_count overlay to percentile chart (UX + api change) 2) annotate p99 with a "unstable" badge when sample_count < 500 3) investigate whether telemetry pipeline drops aborted requests differently between routes.

maria: +1. also add a transient banner when a rollout changes route weights that might cause noisy percentiles for canaries.

nate: I'll open a tiny internal RFC for the TDigest vs bootstrap decision. chao can you capture an example payload set for the cold starts?

chao: will pull traces and attach in the RFC. quick note for ops: deploy-bot reported a config push at 4678911200 that flipped fallback weight from 0.05 -> 0.30. might explain the sudden sample composition shift.

deploy-bot: Config push applied: routing.weight:/generate/fallback=0.30 by @infra (4678911200) :package:

eli: perfect — that lines up. thanks all. I'll prototype the sample_count overlay and a "min_samples" toggle in the console. posting mock in ~2d. :thumbsup:

sam-ux: happy to review mocks. aim for an unobtrusive hint first, not a modal.

maria: one more thought — add a hover tooltip explaining why p95 and p99 can diverge (cache/cold-starts/small-N). helps PMs stop the panic. :raised_hands:
